builtInPrompts.name: A-环形河谷
builtInPrompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: candidate battlefield terrain illustration for a 2D Takeover RTS game, NOT UI. Input 1 is a contact sheet of ALL 25 original maps as topological/style reference ONLY, never paste/stitch its panels. Input 2 is original terrain texture/decor references for four factions: green grass, red orange dry land, blue snow, purple gray cracked wasteland. Create ONE new large organically continuous playable landmass, in the original low-detail hand painted 2D isometric Flash game style. Flat overhead playing surface with shallow isometric cliffs only along the outer perimeter, modest texture, small original-like mountains/trees around route edges. Broad light beige gently curving interconnected roads, generous uncluttered circular junctions and building pads, four comparable starting areas at the four peripheral corners, central contested village clearing, secondary junctions and several neutral treasure clearings. Approx 16-20 building clearings, alternate routes so no one choke blocks a faction. Country textures follow natural terrain contours, mix at irregular borders WITHOUT rectangular quarters or straight panel seams. No buildings, soldiers, labels, text, flags, interface, grid, bridges, gold treasure art, ogres. Clean terrain only so existing original animated buildings/entities can later be layered. Land should fill entire 4:3 image with playable center, highest possible crisp resolution. Gameplay perspective consistent everywhere; no tall 3D cinematic scene. Existing original country territory frames will still determine captured regions in the eventual game; this is a concept reference, not a replacement animation. Composition: one broad oval continental basin, green moist western fields, ochre eastern ridges, snow at northern elevation, cracked gray southern valley. A narrow blue meandering stream around part of the central grassy clearing; every road stays on continuous land. Curved outer road ring and 3 curved connecting routes to center. NO artificial bridges.
